title: Fix destructible distribution, auto-attack pets, remove click requirement
description: A) ZoneService - distribute destructibles randomly across the zone floor (200x2x200 studs), spawn 15-20 per zone with spacing. B) PetController - pets auto-attack nearest destructible within 40 studs, no click required. C) Main.client.lua - remove/simplify click-to-attack logic since pets attack automatically.
steps: Update ZoneService.lua to spawn 20 destructibles randomly distributed across zone floor area
Update PetController.lua to add auto-attack loop that finds and attacks nearest destructible
Update Main.client.lua to remove mandatory click-to-attack and let auto-attack handle it
acceptance_criteria: Destructibles spawn randomly distributed across the full zone area (not clustered)
At least 20 destructibles per zone (mixed types)
Pets automatically detect and attack nearest destructible within radius
No click required for pets to attack
Attack remote fires automatically every 1.5 seconds when in range
